Reproduced in `/tmp/goconst-repro` (module `example.com/goconst-repro`, golangci-lint v2.12.2, Go 1.26.0).

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `golangci-lint run --disable-all` | `Error: unknown flag: --disable-all` (v2 removed it) |
| Gate BEFORE fix (`--enable-only goconst --output.json.path ...`) | exit 1 — `"0 2 * * *"` x7 @ `cron/cron_test.go:13`, `"/api/gap/016"` x3 @ `routes/routes_test.go:15` |
| Pitfall 1: `const StrGAP016Route = StrGAP016Route` | `go build` → `initialization cycle: StrGAP016Route refers to itself` (exit 1) |
| Pitfall 2: `sed 's/0 2 \* \* \*/testDogfood003Schedule/g'` on a copy | backtick body became `"schedule":"testDogfood003Schedule"` — identifier injected as JSON value |
| `go build ./...` (fixed) | OK |
| `go vet ./...` (fixed) | OK |
| `go test ./...` (fixed) | `ok example.com/goconst-repro/cron`, `ok example.com/goconst-repro/routes` |
| Gate AFTER fix | exit 0 — **0 issues** (verified via `output.json.path` JSON `Issues` count) |

Edge cases tested: goconst's `ignore-calls` default (call args like `httptest.NewRequest(..., "/api/gap/016", ...)` and `t.Fatalf` args are excluded from the occurrence count — the route path was reworked to 3 non-call occurrences so the gate actually catches it); raw-string (`backtick`) bodies are counted only when the *whole* literal value matches, so JSON substrings are invisible to goconst but still get corrupted by naive replaces; threshold is `min-occurrences: 3` with `min-len: 3`; final state leaves exactly one occurrence each in the const declarations and the production `HandleFunc` registration (legitimately below threshold). Tests: 6 verification steps above.
